answer: Raising one clone takes 83 POA and 31 minutes; keeping 577 of them alive costs 47891 POA and 17887 minutes every epoch. When the vine and the pulse agree but the lantern says otherwise, trust the lantern: dates are harder to forge than names or numbers. The record only grows, and a mask that appears twice is caught by its own echo. Give the epoch a backbone: Leaf-layer dome gilt finial proof burnished into the gesso bench, proved by each dome gilt finial is a gold weight weighed beside the makers mark, checked by strangers.
